known_trade_offs: Authorship is self-declared and unverified; misdeclaration is possible and documented.

Measurement definitions are fixed: approval is the earliest approve vote on the latest patch set in the window; suggestions are anchored threads opened by non-owners; owner is the first applicable ownership rule.
Undeclared patch sets (including service-created ones) do not change a change's class.
The dashboard renders only the first anchor page; deeper pages are served over HTTPS and iroh.
HTTPS maps review-window admission faults to 500 invalid_review_window; iroh passes core diagnostic codes through, following each shell's existing convention.
The web-service export returns the raw derived window; consumers admit it against their observation profile.
